title: Text Stats Functions
prompt: Implement three functions over a sentence: `word_count(text)` (space-separated words, non-empty), `longest_word(text)` (first longest on ties), and `contains_digit(text)` (true if any character is a digit).

tests.name: longest
tests.hint: First of the longest words wins (lists/linked are 6; linked is first).

tests.name: digit detection
tests.hint: std::isdigit on each char (cast to unsigned char first).

tests.name: tie returns first
tests.hint: On equal length, keep the FIRST word seen (use > not >=).
